pretreatment: Cyclic sputtering with 500-eV Ar+ followed by heating to -1100 K for about 20 s
evidence: The Ge(100) samples, of size 0.35X1.2X0.04 cm, were cut from commercial n-type wafers with a resistivity of about 1 Q cm. Cyclic sputtering with 500-eV Ar+ followed by heating to -1100 K for about 20 s yielded a clean surface exhibiting a sharp (2X1) diffraction pattern.
